source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of gas chromatography (PDF 181-183).

blocks.text: Gas chromatography (GC) gases, urne wale maaye aur gas ki shakal mein thos alag karti hai. Stationary phase aik ghair urne wala, oonche ubalne ke darje wala maaye hai, jaise lambi zanjeer wala non-polar hydrocarbon, jo silica (SiO2) ya alumina (Al2O3) ke chhote zarron se jura hota hai. Mobile phase helium ya nitrogen jaisi be-asar carrier gas hai. Sample injector port mein dala jata, jahan oven use jaldi bukharat banata, aur carrier gas bukharat ko bari satah wale nanhe zarron se bhare lambe lipte column se guzarti hai, jahan alag hona hota hai.

Mixture ke non-polar maadde stationary phase ke zarron par non-polar maaye se zyada amal karte hain, is liye column se aahista guzarte hain. Zyada amal karne wale maadde aahista aur baqi tez chalte hain, aur yun alag hote hain. Alag hue maadde column se nikal kar detector se guzarte hain jo unhein chromatogram kehlane wale graph par peaks ki shakal mein darj karta hai. Kisi maadde ka column se guzarne ka waqt us ka retention time hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: carrier gas (helium ya nitrogen) injector port mein dakhil hoti jahan sample dala aur bukharat banaya jata; gas use oven ke lipte column se detector tak aur bahar le jati, aur recorder chromatogram banata. Neeche: retention time ke muqable detector signal ka chromatogram, teen tikoni peaks A, B aur C, aur formule peak ka area = 1/2 x base x height aur A ka % = A ka area / areas ka majmua x 100.
blocks.caption: Gas chromatograph aur chromatogram (Figure 28.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Har juzw apne retention time par column se nikalta hai, jo us ki pehchan karata hai. Har peak ke neeche ka area us juzw ki miqdar ke mutanasib hai, is liye areas ka muqabla mixture ki banawat deta hai.

blocks.text: GC zyada hassasiyat, achhi alahdgi, tez tajziya aur durust miqdari paimaish rakhti hai; gases ke mixtures kamre ke darja hararat par aasani se alag hote hain. Yeh miqdari tareeqa hai: peaks pehchan kar har aik ka area napa jata hai jo har juzw ka tanasub deta hai. Kyunke peaks taqreeban tikoni hain, peak ka area = 1/2 x base x height, aur teen esters A, B aur C ke mixture ke liye, A ka % = (A ka peak area / A, B aur C ke peak areas ka majmua) x 100. Agar peaks bohat patli hon ya un ki base barabar ho to area ki jagah peak ki unchai use hoti hai. GC khiladiyon mein steroids aur car race ke eendhan ki jaanch mein use hoti hai.

items: Sanat: mayaar ki jaanch aur mahol ki hifazat; petrochemical plants eendhan ka tajziya karte, aur mahol ke namoonon mein organic aaloodgi ke zarre dhoonde jate hain.
Forensic science: khoon mein alcohol (BAC) ke test aur hayatiyati namoonon mein ghair qanooni dawaiyan, zehr aur karkardagi barhane wale maadde dhoondna.
Khurak aur mashroobat: yaksaniyat aur hifazat jaanchna, nazar aane se pehle bacteria ya fungi ki kharabi pakarna, aur khushbuon, teilon aur zaiqon ka tajziya.
Tibb: saans ya peshab ke compounds se metabolism ki bimariyon ki tashkhees, aur nayi dawaiyon mein bache solvents ya gandagi ki jaanch.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Kitab China ka aik forensic waqia bayan karti hai: 2005 mein do parosi bachchon ko chooha maar zehr (fluoroacetate) dene ke ilzaam wala aadmi 2013 mein, aath saal baad, rihaa hua jab gas chromatography ne dikhaya ke khurak ke namoone mein zehr nahi tha.

items: Yeh sirf urne wale (aasani se bukharat banne wale) maaddon ke liye kaam karti hai.
Namoone garmi mein mustahkam hone chahiye; zyada darje par tootne wale compounds ka tajziya nahi ho sakta.
Proteins aur polymers jaise bare biomolecules ka tajziya nahi ho sakta kyunke yeh aasani se bukharat nahi bante.
Aalaat aur un ki dekh bhaal mehngi hai.

blocks.title: GC mass spectrometry ke saath
blocks.text: Forensic kaam mein GC aksar mass spectrometer se jori jati hai (GC-MS): column se nikalne wala har juzw seedha mass spectrometer mein jata, jis ka spectrum us ki pehchan karata, jab ke peak ka area us ki miqdar napta hai, bohat thori miqdar ke liye bhi.

blocks.prompt: Lactic acid, CH3CH(OH)COOH, ke na-khalis namoone mein wahid milawat butanone hai aur GC se tajziya hota hai. (i) Munasib mobile aur stationary phases batayein. (ii) Chromatogram se feesad banawat kaise maloom hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: (i) Mobile phase: be-asar carrier gas jaise helium ya nitrogen; stationary phase: silica ya alumina ke zarron par chadha ghair urne wala, oonche ubalne ke darje wala maaye (jaise lambi zanjeer wala hydrocarbon). (ii) Har peak ka area napein (1/2 x base x height); butanone ka % = butanone peak ka area / (dono peak areas ka majmua) x 100, aur isi tarah lactic acid ka.

items: GC: carrier gas (He, N2) mobile phase; silica/alumina par ghair urne wala maaye stationary.
Retention time pehchan; peak area (1/2 x base x height) miqdar.
Sirf urne wale, garmi mein mustahkam namoone; forensic pehchan ke liye GC-MS.
